Name: Labelled Chests
Author: laralasagna
Description:
BUG FIX: Realised that upon saving and exiting the game, the chest labels didn't save. This has been fixed :)

How it works:

While hovering over a chest, press CTRL + L to open a small menu where you can name it. Press 'OK', and the chest’s label will now appear above it in white text with a semi-transparent black highlight whenever you hover over it.

- Compatible with mods like "Automate".
- Compatible with multiplayer. If your friends also have the mod, everyone will see the chest labels.
- All chests will have a default "chest" label until you change it.


Hope you like it! I'll be using this mod myself so if I notice any issues I'll be sure to fix and update.

Manifest.Name: ChestHoverLabel
Manifest.Description: Shows the custom name of a chest when you hover over it.
